# `aitbc node bridge reject`

Reject a bridge request from another island.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc node bridge reject [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--request-id` | text | — | yes | The Request id. |
| `--reason` | text | — | no | Rejection reason |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc node bridge reject --request-id <request_id>
```
